title: Legislative Palace of Uruguay
geometryBasis: The named OSM civic building relation 20800840 supplies a footprint with 32 outer vertices, four true courtyards, and the cardinal portico projections. The mapped south portico fixes heading. Stairs and ramps project beyond the wall trace.
sectionBasis: Parliament and Montevideo records establish the approximately 40 m upper lantern, three stories above a basement, use of local marble and the central glass over crossed barrel vaults. The exact image fixes the front stair breaks, columns, entablature, raised lantern piers and podium.
limitations: Standing exterior. The native map grounds the building wall projections and four open light courts. Individual statues, coats of arms, cornice carving and concealed roof details are interpreted at medium fidelity.
Main stairs, ramp grades, window depths, rear capital details and exact height datums are approximate. The original source elevation samples are retained independently.
The ensemble is the palace itself with its attached podium and principal approach. Interior rooms, perimeter gardens, and transport or utility fixtures are outside the documented scope.
